subsets.name: Splat Base 1/1 Auto
subsets.note: Three Splat designs (a / b / c), each signed. Designs a and b fill ten 1/1 parallel slots (P01–P10) per foil; design c fills five (P01–P05). Every parallel is a one-of-one. Card codes carry ‹INI› in place of the specific pose (JB1 or JB2) captured on that one-of-one, matching the Player Checklist below.
